en:
WASD / arrows — move
Shift — run
Space — jump
Mouse — look around
Left button — grab the rat
Left button (holding) — strangle
1 2 3 — switch weapon
E — use the computer
E (holding) — clean a sprung trap ($2 to set it again)
Esc — release the mouse

Espaço — pular
Mouse — olhar ao redor

E — usar o computador
E (segurando) — limpar uma armadilha disparada ($2 para armar de novo)
Esc — soltar o mouse
